plainText:
Todd Michael Haberkorn is a Vietnamese-American voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is represented by Atlas Talent in Los Angeles, The Horne Agency in Houston, GoVoices in Colorado, and The People Store in Atlanta.

==Biography==
Haberkorn was born on August 16, 1982, in Arlington, Texas. He attended the Southern Methodist University in Dallas and received a Bachelor's Degree of Fine Arts as an adult. Afterwards, Haberkorn joined as a voice actor and started out with minor voicing roles on English dubs for Japanese anime series. However, as time passed, he went on to voice major characters and landed a number of well-known roles. In addition to voice acting, Haberkorn has also directed and produced some works.
